formatNote: Exported as 2x PNG. SVG was not practical: these are live DOM compositions using backdrop-filter, radial gradients and variable-font settings, which do not survive a DOM-to-SVG conversion faithfully. The master HTML is the vector-accurate source; request SVG per component if a specific one is needed for implementation.

components.name: Button variants
components.accessibilityRules: 44x44 minimum target, visible focus ring, accessible name on icon-only controls, status never by colour alone.
components.notes: Geometry, radius and colour are unchanged from source. Added: 44x44 minimum target, a visible focus ring, accessible names on icon-only controls (correction A-01).

components.name: Identity — avatars, chips, badges
variants: owner / member / pending / unclaimed / inactive / you badges
states: owner / member / pending / unclaimed / inactive / you badges
components.accessibilityRules: 44x44 minimum target, visible focus ring, accessible name on icon-only controls, status never by colour alone.
components.notes: Avatar fill and border keep the source colour+22 / colour+66 formula. Participant colour identifies a person only. Role always carries a word plus a glyph, never colour alone. Sixth participant onward uses warm neutral #C8B8A6 (exception E-09).

components.name: Group switcher
components.sourceAnalogue: New — extends the header identity chip
components.accessibilityRules: 44x44 minimum target, visible focus ring, accessible name on icon-only controls, status never by colour alone.
components.notes: A menu anchored under the header chip, capped at the column width, never a full page. Single-Group accounts see the chip without a caret.

components.name: Rows and cards
components.accessibilityRules: 44x44 minimum target, visible focus ring, accessible name on icon-only controls, status never by colour alone.
components.notes: 56px row-height floor so the whole row is a comfortable target. Dashed borders are reserved for pending or unclaimed. Expense rows carry historical recorder attribution.

components.name: Invitation card states
components.accessibilityRules: 44x44 minimum target, visible focus ring, accessible name on icon-only controls, status never by colour alone.
components.notes: One card carries every invitation state; only the eyebrow, border and footer change. Never implies acceptance before the server confirms.

components.name: Sheet, dialog, confirmation
components.accessibilityRules: 44x44 minimum target, visible focus ring, accessible name on icon-only controls, status never by colour alone.
components.notes: Overlay rgba(15,11,8,.82), blur 14px, 480px cap, 20px radius, 22px padding, slide-up entry, scroll inside the overlay. Destructive actions gain confirmation, focus trapping and focus restoration (exception E-02).

components.name: Text, email and password inputs
components.accessibilityRules: 44x44 minimum target, visible focus ring, accessible name on icon-only controls, status never by colour alone.
components.notes: Fill, border and focus behaviour are NeonInput. Added: a visible label, a 3px soft accent focus ring, and errors tied to their field (corrections A-03, A-04).

components.name: Currency, textarea, search, segmented, toggle
components.accessibilityRules: 44x44 minimum target, visible focus ring, accessible name on icon-only controls, status never by colour alone.
components.notes: Segmented control and currency pairing are lifted from the current expense dialog. Every toggle gains a visible label, a helper line stating what off means, and a 44px row.

components.name: Validation timing and form feedback
components.accessibilityRules: 44x44 minimum target, visible focus ring, accessible name on icon-only controls, status never by colour alone.
components.notes: Documents when each check fires. The form-level summary moves focus to the first offending field and is announced politely.

components.name: Loading, skeleton, in progress
components.accessibilityRules: 44x44 minimum target, visible focus ring, accessible name on icon-only controls, status never by colour alone.
components.notes: Three pulsing rows reused verbatim for member lists, documents and settlements. Polite loading status for screen readers; pulse dropped under reduced motion.

components.name: Empty states
components.sourceAnalogue: Confirmed — Todo and Settle Up empty states
components.accessibilityRules: 44x44 minimum target, visible focus ring, accessible name on icon-only controls, status never by colour alone.
components.notes: Fraunces line, Inter line, one action. Playful tone is allowed here and only here.

components.name: Connection states
components.accessibilityRules: 44x44 minimum target, visible focus ring, accessible name on icon-only controls, status never by colour alone.
components.notes: Sits as a pill directly under the sticky header, inside the column. Never covers content, never animates in from the edge.

components.name: Permission and access states
components.accessibilityRules: 44x44 minimum target, visible focus ring, accessible name on icon-only controls, status never by colour alone.
components.notes: No status codes, no policy names. Each block states the limit then the next move, and names a person who can help where one exists.

components.name: Member and participant rows
components.sourceAnalogue: Extended — derived from UserChips.tsx and the current 56px list row
components.accessibilityRules: 56px minimum row height; 44x44 kebab; role and status always word plus glyph so colour is never the only signal; name and initial always visible on neutral avatars; dashed ring conveys unclaimed alongside the 'Unclaimed' badge.
components.notes: One row shell, six meanings. Migrated five keep their emoji (O-04); everyone else is initials on warm neutral #C8B8A6, dashed while unclaimed (E-09). Roles are Owner and Member only (O-01).

components.name: Read-only Group banner
components.sourceAnalogue: New — no analogue; nearest is the connection banner (CMP-12)
components.accessibilityRules: Never labelled Viewer. Announced as a status region on entry; the action inside is a real 44px control with an accessible name.

components.name: Permission explanation card
components.sourceAnalogue: Extended — from the batch-1 permission block on board 07
components.accessibilityRules: Heading is the rule, body is the next safe action, mono line carries the state so it is never colour-only. Associated with the control it explains via aria-describedby.

components.name: Unavailable-resource state
components.sourceAnalogue: New — page-level; extends the batch-1 empty-state geometry
components.accessibilityRules: Identical layout for every cause. Neutral mark has no alt text requirement because it carries no information; the heading is the h1 of the page and takes focus on entry.

components.name: Owner-only setting row
components.sourceAnalogue: Extended — from the configuration row on board 05
components.accessibilityRules: 56px minimum. Disabled rows are not focusable and are not announced as buttons; the OWNER ONLY marker is read as part of the row label.

components.name: Last-Owner protection notice
components.accessibilityRules: Lives inside the blocking confirmation sheet. The unblock action replaces the blocked primary so no dead control receives focus.

components.name: Server-denied form summary
components.sourceAnalogue: Extended — from the form-level error block on board 06
components.accessibilityRules: Takes focus on appearance, announced politely, and is the accessible description of the disabled submit. Input stays visible and copyable.

components.name: Private-resource state
components.accessibilityRules: Carries no metadata at all. The omission variant is documentation of an absence, not a rendered placeholder; screen readers encounter nothing where a private item would be.

components.name: Recovery block
components.accessibilityRules: One primary and at most one secondary; 44px minimum. The no-recovery variant renders a sentence, never a disabled button.

components.name: Multi-payer contribution block
components.accessibilityRules: Rows are 44px minimum; each field is labelled by the participant name, and the currency suffix is part of the field label rather than decoration.

components.name: Participant-share display
components.sourceAnalogue: New — no current screen writes custom shares (E-13)
components.accessibilityRules: Three uses only. No arbitrary custom-share authoring: no amount, percentage or weight can be entered, because no such authoring surface exists in the product (O-10). Rows keep 44px targets and per-row accounting equivalents.
components.status: Revised in batch 5 — O-10, E-13 limited

components.name: Exact-total status
components.accessibilityRules: A live region announced on change; it is also the accessible description of the disabled Save. Never colour-only — the tick and the wording carry the state.

components.name: Accounting-currency label
components.sourceAnalogue: Confirmed — header subtitle plus IDR/INR control
components.accessibilityRules: Currency is stated once per Group in the header; figures pair accounting value with original currency so no amount is ambiguous.

components.name: Original / accounting amount row
components.sourceAnalogue: New — assembled from existing mono key/value rows
components.accessibilityRules: Mono key, mono value, no table. The unavailable variant uses an em dash plus accent colour and the word is repeated in the body copy.

components.name: Historical FX explanation
components.accessibilityRules: Two or three statements, never a paragraph. Dismissible; focus returns to the figure that opened it.

components.name: Recorder attribution row
components.sourceAnalogue: New — created_by exists in the model but is not surfaced
components.accessibilityRules: Three separate rows with mono keys. Names are text, avatars are supporting; attribution is never carried by an avatar alone.

components.name: Inactive ledger participant
components.sourceAnalogue: Extended — from CMP-14 rows and E-09
components.accessibilityRules: Warm neutral #C8B8A6 with a dashed ring plus the literal word on the row. No participant-management action is reachable from a ledger row.

components.name: Settlement confirmation summary
components.sourceAnalogue: New — source records on a single tap
components.accessibilityRules: From, to, exact amount in both currencies, what changes, what becomes history — in that order, before an irreversible write.

components.name: Idempotent-result notice
components.accessibilityRules: Never styled as a fresh success. States the existing record and why the screen appeared.

components.name: Finance conflict notice
components.accessibilityRules: Both sides stated; nothing merged, guessed or rounded. The choice stays with the person or with a controlled reconciliation.

components.name: Selected-file row
components.sourceAnalogue: ScanTab selected-file line (file icon + ellipsised name)
components.accessibilityRules: One line, min-width:0, ellipsised at the end and never wrapped. Replace and Remove are 44px targets. The accessible label carries the full filename.

components.name: File-type badge
components.accessibilityRules: Reports the validator’s decision, never the file extension. The same value drives the row glyph so icon and badge cannot disagree.

components.name: Upload progress block
components.accessibilityRules: Progress announced politely, not assertively. Every state names what does not exist yet. Reduced motion replaces the bar animation with a static fill.

components.name: Parsing status
components.accessibilityRules: The accepted spinner reused unmodified. Status changes are announced once, not per frame. Reduced motion shows a static indicator.

components.name: Extracted-field review group
components.accessibilityRules: Every field is a real labelled control with its provenance in the hint. Errors are programmatically associated. Primary action reads Continue until a person has reviewed it.

components.name: Extraction warning
components.accessibilityRules: Caution styling, never error styling, for anything user review can resolve. The summary strip is focusable and moves focus to the first warning.

components.name: Scan provenance badge
components.accessibilityRules: Four words, recorded server-side. Never a provider, model, version or confidence value. Distinct from the manual badge by shape and colour, not colour alone.

components.name: Event presentation summary
components.accessibilityRules: Renders document access and Event presentation as separate statements. The phrase private Event is prohibited. Unclaimed identity keeps warm neutral, dashed ring and a visible name. Corrected in batch 6: this summarises who an extracted Event is presented to. There is no per-document audience; document access is current same-Group authorisation.

components.name: Document list row
components.accessibilityRules: 56px row, single ellipsised line, min-width:0 so a 120-character filename cannot push View off the edge. Status is a labelled badge, never colour alone. Corrected in batch 6: the row shows name, type, upload time, server-derived uploader provenance and Event status. No per-document audience summary is rendered.

components.name: Associated-Event status
components.accessibilityRules: NO EVENT is gold because nothing failed; EVENT MISSING is the defect. Every value is a word as well as a colour.

components.name: Private document viewer shell
components.accessibilityRules: One shell for both types. In-app render from an authorised short-lived read: no address bar, no copyable link, no permanent URL, and no metadata before authorization returns. Escape closes and restores focus to the invoking row.

components.name: Removal impact summary
components.accessibilityRules: Consequences enumerated rather than a bare confirmation. Destructive action is never the focused default; Escape and backdrop cancel.

components.name: Orphan and reconciliation status
components.accessibilityRules: Never reports success it cannot prove, never falls back to a public path, never shows repair controls or operational vocabulary to an ordinary Member.

components.name: Document migration notice
components.accessibilityRules: Calm and counted. No object path, bucket, identifier, error code or service name, and never the old public address.

components.name: Configuration overview row
components.accessibilityRules: One row, three renderings. Value is a single line with nowrap ellipsis; the affordance is absent for a Member rather than disabled. 56px minimum height and a 44px Edit target.

components.name: Settings section header
components.accessibilityRules: A mono label and a hairline. Decorative rule is aria-hidden; the label is the group heading for assistive technology.

components.name: Read-only configuration value
components.accessibilityRules: No dimmed control ever renders. Where the reason is not obvious from context, it reads: Only an Owner can change these details. The word Viewer is never used.

components.name: Editable configuration field
components.accessibilityRules: Extends CMP-08. Validation on submit; the error is announced politely against its own field. The counter renders only when implementation supplies a configured limit — no invented number.

components.name: Date-range editor
components.accessibilityRules: Two fields treated as one value. The range error sits under the pair, not on a field, and dates are never auto-swapped. The Group timezone is named in the read-back line.

components.name: Timezone result row
components.accessibilityRules: Place label above the canonical identifier, always both. Two rows may share one identifier without being duplicates. 52px minimum height.

components.name: IANA timezone identity block
components.accessibilityRules: Canonical IANA identifier presented as identity. No fixed UTC offset is displayed or stored as the canonical value; an abbreviation such as WITA is a presentation of the identifier.

components.name: Configuration impact summary
components.accessibilityRules: Statements, not warnings. Never claims that Events were moved, shifted or repaired. Read as a list by assistive technology.

components.name: Accounting-currency authority card
components.accessibilityRules: Minor units come from the currency, never from a default. Reference conversions render smaller, dimmer and prefixed with an approximation sign so they cannot be mistaken for the obligation.

components.name: Accounting-currency lock notice
components.accessibilityRules: Replaces a selector rather than disabling one. Read as text, not as a disabled control. No Convert everything action exists in any state.

components.name: Display-currency selector
components.accessibilityRules: The accounting currency renders as REQUIRED with no removal affordance. Display context never becomes ledger authority.

components.name: Bali-only content notice
components.accessibilityRules: States the condition as well as the outcome. No worldwide guide is invented for a non-Bali destination.

components.name: Configuration change summary
components.accessibilityRules: One line per field, from and to. Fields validate independently. The accounting currency is omitted entirely when it is not legally editable — never shown as unchanged.

components.name: Stale-configuration notice
components.accessibilityRules: Extends PERM-17. Never auto-merges and never overwrites an active local form; always offers to hand the unsaved text back.

components.name: Migration configuration evidence
components.accessibilityRules: Evidence in product language. No migration table names, database field names or internal identifiers appear in any state.

components.name: Connection-status pill
components.accessibilityRules: Absent when healthy. Sits under the sticky header, never floats. Word plus hue, never hue alone; reduced motion drops the pulse.

components.name: Temporary update toast
components.accessibilityRules: Four seconds, one line, no action. Announced politely; every outcome it carries also lands in durable screen state.

components.name: Persistent contextual update card
components.accessibilityRules: Level 3. Stays until viewed. An invitation to look, never an insertion — the list does not reorder under a reading finger.

components.name: Realtime conflict card
components.accessibilityRules: Level 4, the only realtime surface with actions. Never merges, never overwrites, always states that nothing has been sent.

components.name: Stale-data notice
components.accessibilityRules: Generalised from CMP-61 to any record. One vocabulary for “this changed somewhere else” across the product.

components.name: Remote-change attribution line
components.accessibilityRules: One line explaining why something on screen just moved. Mono timestamp, name in full colour, verb secondary.

components.name: Grouped-update summary
components.accessibilityRules: Collapses a fan-out into one statement. One accepted mutation produces one message, never one per dependent change.

components.name: Out-of-sync notice
components.accessibilityRules: States that the screen may be stale and offers a real refresh. No code, payload, channel name or service name.

components.name: Realtime permission-change notice
components.accessibilityRules: Four causes that must not collapse into one message; each routes somewhere different and means something different.

components.name: Live-update screen-reader status
components.accessibilityRules: The non-visual half of every realtime state. Polite for background updates, assertive only when the person must act now. Never moves focus.

components.name: Maintenance banner
components.accessibilityRules: Banner, never modal. Removed the moment it stops being true, because a stale maintenance notice devalues every banner after it.

components.name: Read-only maintenance state
components.accessibilityRules: Extends CMP-15. Mutation controls absent rather than disabled; copy always states that the account is fine.

components.name: Migration progress step
components.accessibilityRules: Four-step spine in product language. Status differs by fill and weight as well as colour; read as a list by assistive technology.

components.name: Migration status summary
components.accessibilityRules: Refuses to render without status copy. A silent spinner is indistinguishable from a hang.

components.name: Migration warning card
components.accessibilityRules: Success and warning coexist. The warning always carries a destination.

components.name: Safe-stop notice
components.accessibilityRules: States what is authoritative, whether anything partial is exposed, and whether retry exists at all.

components.name: Rollback status
components.accessibilityRules: A running rollback is reported as running. The completed state uses the sanctioned sentence and claims nothing beyond it.

components.name: Recovery status
components.accessibilityRules: Verification creates nothing, deletes nothing and widens no access. Repair restores consistency, never privilege.

components.name: Preserved-data summary
components.accessibilityRules: Counts, not adjectives. Carries a footnote refusing to claim perfection without accepted evidence.

components.name: Claim-after-migration card
components.accessibilityRules: Extends CLM-01. Migration creates the opportunity and never performs the claim; no automatic linking, no Owner review queue.

components.name: Document-security migration notice
components.accessibilityRules: Describes the destination without printing the address being replaced, at any stage.

components.name: Finance-evidence migration card
components.accessibilityRules: The four finance facts a reviewer will test. Live-rate substitution is named explicitly as absent.

components.name: Migration truth-state badge
components.accessibilityRules: Six mutually exclusive claims. The weakest badge the evidence supports is the one used; readable in greyscale.

components.name: Implementation-readiness gate card
components.accessibilityRules: The release gate as a design object. Fully protected or unavailable; no degraded middle setting.
